create_load_pdf_document: create a PyMuPdfDocumentBackend to load a PDF from a file path or BytesIO stream
get_page_text_from_bbox: get text from a PDF page within a specified bounding box region
extract_text_cells_from_page: extract text cells with bounding boxes and angles from a PDF page
get_pdf_page_geometry: get PDF page geometry including crop, media, art, bleed, and trim boxes
render_page_as_image: render a PDF page as a PIL Image with optional scaling and cropping
